name: LexisNexis
sells: consumer identity verification and fraud risk scoring
public records aggregation and background screening
insurance claims and CLUE underwriting reports

optOut.notes: LexisNexis provides a dedicated self-service web form at https://optout.lexisnexis.com/ for US consumers to submit 'Do Not Sell or Share My Personal Information' and information suppression requests across LexisNexis public-records and risk products, as documented in its Vermont Data Broker Registry filing and US Privacy Policy (https://www.lexisnexis.com/en-us/terms/privacy-policy.page).
